verses.text: Hallelujah! You servants of the Lord, praise him. Praise the name of the Lord.
Thank the name of the Lord now and forever.
From where the sun rises to where the sun sets, the name of the Lord should be praised.
The Lord is high above all the nations. His glory is above the heavens.
Who is like the Lord our God? He is seated on his high throne.
He bends down to look at heaven and earth.
He lifts the poor from the dust. He lifts the needy from a garbage heap.
He seats them with influential people, with the influential leaders of his people.
He makes a woman who is in a childless home a joyful mother. Hallelujah!
